text: Look! Just take a look at that, [VAR 0100(0000)]!\c\nThat’s Turffield Stadium down there![VAR 0114(0005)]

The Gym Leader just returned, too.
Milo’s his name.\c
But the place is jam-packed with challengers.
It’ll be ages before our turn comes up...[VAR 0114(0005)]

Oh...
But Sonia was looking for you, [VAR 0100(0000)].\c
She wanted to ask you about something.
She tried asking me, but I had no idea.\c
She’s up on that what’s-her-face hill.
You know the one.[VAR 0114(0005)]
What? You don’t know the hill?\nWell, have a look at your map if you’re not sure![VAR 0114(0005)]
Oh! If it isn’t Sonia’s Yamper!\nHe’s a good boy. He’ll show you the way![VAR 0114(0005)]

Sonia’s probably still waiting for you at the hill,
[VAR 0100(0000)].\c
Go on and meet her. You can’t take on Milo yet
anyway, and I don’t want her griping to me later
as if I didn’t pass on the message![VAR 0114(0005)]
